data.title: 卡芙卡 · 绒床上的紫色丝线
data.description: 成年卡芙卡独自仰卧绒床，黑丝双腿屈起，一手按胸、一手在腿间自抚，紫色丝线与湿润痕迹沿床褥扩散。

data.promptProse: Adult Kafka lies alone on the velvet bed with both knees raised, one hand on her breast and the other touching herself. Violet threads gather across the bedding. Warm yellow bedside wall light falls softly across the dark silk bedding.
data.animaCaption: Violet threads gather across the bedding beside her raised knees.
